# 想要体验《僵尸世界大战》电影中那种丧尸堆叠的效果吗？[Do you want a zombie stacking effect like in the World War Z movies?]
1. 进入第二阶段后，如果你试图站在高处，丧尸会踩着同伴的头部向上攀爬，最终堆叠在一起[After entering the second stage, if you try to stand on a high place, then the zombie will climb up on the head of a companion and end up stacking on top of each other]
2. 当矿工丧尸挖掘方块时，你可以在副手装备对应物品，右键点击来修复该方块。你可以使用配置文件指定方块及其对应的修复材料[When a miner zombie digs a block, you can equip the corresponding item on the off-hand, right-click the mouse to repair the block, and use the configuration file to specify the block and the corresponding repair material]
3. 本模组提供了多种配置选项以控制游戏难度[Mods offer a variety of configuration options to control the difficulty]
4. 随着游戏天数的推移，灾难阶段会逐渐提升，并开始生成不同类型的丧尸[As the game progresses, the stage of the disaster will gradually increase, and different types of zombies will begin to spawn]
5. 模组包含多种丧尸类型：普通丧尸、奔跑丧尸、强壮丧尸、进化丧尸、仅半截身体却能搬运玩家的丧尸、搭建丧尸以及矿工丧尸[The mod provides normal zombies, running zombies, strong zombies, evolutionary zombies, zombies that can carry players with only half of their bodies, building zombies, and miner zombies]
6. 模组支持尸潮机制，会在玩家附近生成大量丧尸[The mod provides a wave of corpses that spawns a large number of zombies near the player]
7. 请使用光源方块防止丧尸在你的家中生成，哈哈哈哈[Please use light source blocks to prevent zombies from spawning in your home, hahahaha]
### **本模组依赖 GeckoLib [Module uses GeckoLib as dependency]**
